name: CloudCLI
profile: Our setup: one developer self-hosts his own fork of CloudCLI (1.37.x) as the single workspace where he drives several agent CLIs - Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity/Gemini - plus his own provider router for models like deepseek and gemini. He keeps his real projects in it: a large PHP/PostgreSQL insurance backend (29 of 96 recorded sessions), insurance provider integrations and dictionaries (17), local Linux infrastructure over SSH (9), SQL/ELK data analysis (7), small external sites (4), and work on this tool itself (12 sessions, 342 user messages - his longest threads). Evidence from those 96 sessions, what he keeps asking of the product: (1) a session must be reliable like a messenger - websocket reconnect, live streaming of text and tool calls, no endless 'loading tool' states, subagent start/finish visible without a page reload, usable from a phone; (2) every agent CLI and provider in one window, including non-Anthropic models; (3) session history turned into a task board and a session map, grouped by product, so he never searches old sessions by hand; (4) his own artifact system - previews and tables rendered in the browser, artifacts with attached .md/.html/.xlsx files, per-artifact TTL, 'download last answer as .md'; (5) files the agent touched openable in the built-in explorer by click; (6) headless install and auth of agent CLIs. He merges upstream releases into his own fork every version, so small, self-contained, easy-to-rebase fixes matter more than sweeping refactors. He does not want telemetry, vendor lock-in, or integrations tied to one commercial service.

areas.providers_cli: Agent provider integrations and CLI adapters: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini/Antigravity, OpenCode, Qwen; CLI auth, model lists, runtime wrapper, provider settings
areas.sessions_streaming: Sessions and the chat stream: session list/history/transcripts, resume and fork, websockets, live output, subagent runs and completion, mobile reconnect
areas.permissions_auth: Users, login, permissions, guest and shared access, tokens and stored credentials
areas.files_git: File tree and explorer, file editing from the chat, git panel, diffs, branches and worktrees
areas.tasks_board: Task board, TaskMaster, session tasks and statuses, notes, scheduled messages
areas.artifacts: Artifacts: browser previews, shared links and passwords, downloads, attached files, retention/TTL, assets
areas.ui_ux: Web UI: layout, themes, components, mobile viewport, styling and keyboard shortcuts
areas.deploy_desktop: Install, hosting, Docker, self-host, desktop (Electron) builds, service exposure (Caddy/nginx), updates and release tooling
areas.mcp_plugins: MCP servers, plugins and extension points, project and workspace handling
